title: Suárez 2013-14 v Salah 2024-25: Liverpool's best ever season?
checked: Suarez: ten-match ban for biting Ivanovic, April 2013, carried into 2013-14; Arsenal's summer bid (BBC, Wikipedia Suarez). 31 league goals in 33 games, Sturridge 21, Liverpool 101 league goals (Wikipedia season, Wikipedia PL). Norwich 5-1, 4 Dec 2013, four goals, the first from about 40 yards over Ruddy (NESN, Sky Sports). Liverpool 0-2 Chelsea 27 Apr 2014 after Gerrard's slip; Palace 3-3 from 3-0 up, 5 May 2014 (Wikipedia season, BBC). Table City 86, Liverpool 84, Chelsea 82 (Wikipedia). PFA and FWA 2014 (Wikipedia Suarez). Salah: 32 at the start of 2024-25, contract to June 2025, new deal signed 11 April 2025 (Liverpool FC, Wikipedia season). 29 goals, 18 assists, 47 involvements a 38-game record; Golden Boot, Playmaker, PFA, FWA (Wikipedia PL, Liverpool FC, Sports Mole). 5-1 v Spurs 27 Apr 2025, Salah's 63rd-minute 4-1 from Szoboszlai (ESPN, Sports Mole). Table Liverpool 84, Arsenal 74, City 71 (Wikipedia). Gameplay: Suarez at Norwich and Salah v Spurs recreated with gamecap (specs suarez-2013, salah-2025; Spurs' light blue from Tottenham's own preview).

lines.text: Same club. Same shirt. Same eighty-four points. One got the title. One got heartbreak.
lines.say: Same club. Same shirt. Same eighty-four points. One got the title. One got heartbreak.

lines.text: Summer 2013. Luis Suárez is banned for ten games for biting, and he wants out.

scene.headline: Suárez banned for ten games
scene.standfirst: The Liverpool striker will miss the start of next season after biting Branislav Ivanović. Arsenal want to sign him.

lines.say: Summer, twenty thirteen. Looees Swahrez is banned for ten games for biting, and he wants out.

lines.text: He stays, and scores thirty-one in thirty-three games. Against Norwich, one from forty yards.
lines.say: He stays, and scores thirty-one in thirty-three games. Against Norritch, one from forty yards.

lines.text: Then Chelsea at Anfield. Gerrard slips. Liverpool lose two-nil.

scene.note: Gerrard slips, and the title slips with it

lines.say: Then Chelsea at Anfield. Gerrard slips. Liverpool lose two-nil.

lines.text: Then Palace. Three-nil up with eleven minutes left. It ends three-three. Suárez cries into his shirt.
lines.say: Then Palace. Three-nil up with eleven minutes left. It ends three-three. Swahrez cries into his shirt.

lines.text: City win the league by two points. Eighty-four wasn't enough.
lines.say: City win the league by two points. Eighty-four wasn't enough.

lines.text: 2024-25. Mohamed Salah is thirty-two, and his contract is running out.
lines.say: Twenty twenty four, twenty five. Mohamed Sahlah is thirty two, and his contract is running out.

lines.text: Twenty-nine goals, eighteen assists. Forty-seven goal involvements, a record for a thirty-eight game season.
lines.say: Twenty-nine goals, eighteen assists. Forty-seven goal involvements, a record for a thirty-eight game season.

lines.text: In April, he signs a new deal. Sixteen days later, Spurs come to Anfield.

scene.headline: Salah signs new Liverpool contract
scene.standfirst: The Egyptian commits his future to the club with the title race nearly won.

lines.say: In April, he signs a new deal. Sixteen days later, Spurs come to Anfield.

lines.text: Szoboszlai finds Salah. Four-one. Liverpool are champions.
lines.say: Sohbossloy finds Sahlah. Four-one. Liverpool are champions.

lines.text: Eighty-four points again. This time, ten points clear.
lines.say: Eighty-four points again. This time, ten points clear.

lines.text: Both won the Golden Boot. Both swept the player awards. Same points. One title.
lines.say: Both won the Golden Boot. Both swept the player awards. Same points. One title.

lines.text: Suárez was the better show. Salah had the better season. Settled: Salah.
lines.say: Swahrez was the better show. Sahlah had the better season. Settled: Sahlah.
